# Proof

**Claim:** The health endpoint reports ok after the deploy

**Evidence:** `<run>`

## Findings

### 1. ✅ Proven: The health endpoint reports ok on the new revision

Before the deploy it reported down; after, ok with version 43.

**o1** · before · app.example /health on revision app-00042 · exited 1 · 2026-10-28T12:00:00Z

```console
$ curl -s https://app.example/health
```

stdout line 1 of 1, from `observations/o1.stdout`:

```text
status: down
```

**o2** · after · app.example /health on revision app-00043 · exited 0 · 2026-10-28T12:05:00Z

```console
$ curl -s https://app.example/health
```

stdout lines 1 to 2 of 3, from `observations/o2.stdout`:

```text
status: ok
version: 43
```

**o3** · after · https://app.example/settings on revision app-00043 · file `observations/o3-screenshot.png` · sha256 ea80334363eed145dfeee51ebae7dc3f1cd7d0c7879f8bfd2070c061d3c33f56 · 9 bytes · 2026-10-28T12:06:00Z

### 2. ❓ Not observable here: Alerts fire when the endpoint is down

Triggering an outage in dev needs approval.

**What would make it observable:** Approval to stop the dev API for one minute
